$comment: Vetted, ready-to-register MCP server blocks drawn from punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers.
Nothing here is active until you register it: scripts/mcp-register.py add <id> merges an
entry's `config` into .mcp.json. Entries listing `env` need those variables set first.
The full 3356-server index lives in catalogs/mcp-servers.tsv - query it with
scripts/catalog.py, then use scripts/mcp-register.py block to generate a block for

filesystem.description: Read and write files under explicitly allowed directories.
filesystem.notes: Replace the trailing path arguments with the directories you want exposed. Only listed directories are reachable.

git.description: Read, search, and inspect the history of a local git repository.
git.notes: Point --repository at the repo you want exposed.

fetch.description: Fetch a URL and convert the page to markdown for the model to read.
fetch.notes: Useful when you want page content without a full browser.

memory.notes: Stores to a local JSON file; set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to relocate it.

sequential-thinking.notes: No credentials, no network access of its own.

playwright.description: Drive a real browser: navigate, click, fill forms, screenshot, extract.
playwright.notes: The natural pairing with the easyspider skill when a scrape needs a headed browser rather than a saved EasySpider task.

postgres.description: Query and inspect a PostgreSQL database.
postgres.notes: Pairs with a free Postgres tier found via the free-infra skill (Neon, Supabase, Prisma Postgres).

sqlite.description: Query a local SQLite database file.
sqlite.notes: Handy for querying scraped data that EasySpider exported. Point --db-path at your file.
